title: 第15章 血护法第16章 逃出水府
lines: 这一变故，令许辰瞳孔不由一缩。
到底为什么？
杜重他们为什么会突然袭杀自己人？
不对！
这些人神志不清。
这是被控制了！
随着四大年轻高手两死两伤，大殿内忽然混乱了起来，一些人上一刻还好好的，下一刻忽然发疯，对着身边人下杀手。
许辰一剑挥出，一名向他杀来的武者，尸首分离。
却在此时。
“轰隆隆！”
大殿忽然震动了起来。
大殿深处。
一块巨大石门缓缓升起。
随着石门的升起，浓郁的血腥气扑面而来。
许辰闻声看去。
透过那缓缓开启的石门，隐约看到了一方巨大的血池。
血池之中，血水翻滚，池中央，盘坐着一尊皮包着骨头的‘尸骸’。
那就是水府主人吧！
看到这儿，许辰哪里还不明白。
水府就是个阴谋。
他们这些进入水府的武者，落入到了别人的圈套之中，成为他人复苏的养料。
“不能让水府之主复苏，否则我们都要交代在这儿。”
灰衣老人大喝道。
下一刻。
灰衣老人，红衣美妇人，向着那血池暴掠而去。
许辰认为灰衣老人说的有理，也是毫不犹豫的杀向血池。
要在水府之主复苏过来之前，将之斩杀。
但事情岂会发展的那么顺利。
灰衣老人，红衣美妇人，即将冲入血池之中时，低沉的呼啸声忽然响彻，只见，一条粗大的蟒尾，席卷着可怕的威势，狠狠抽甩而来。
灰衣老人和红衣美妇人，虽有灵器在手，但还是被震的连连后退。
“哗啦啦～”
content_en:
This incident made Xu Chen's pupils shrink.
Why?
Why did Du Zhong and the others suddenly attack and kill their own people?
wrong!
These people are delirious.
This is being controlled!
With two of the four young masters dead and two wounded, chaos suddenly broke out in the hall. Some people were fine one moment, but suddenly went crazy the next, killing those around them.
"Poof!"
Xu Chen swung his sword, and the body of a warrior who was coming towards him was separated.
But at this time.
"Boom!"
The hall suddenly shook.
Deep in the hall.
A huge stone door slowly rose.
As the stone gate rose, the rich smell of blood hit his face.
Xu Chen heard the sound and looked over.
Through the slowly opening stone door, a huge pool of blood could be vaguely seen.
In the blood pool, the blood was rolling, and in the center of the pool sat a 'corpse' wrapped in skin and bones.
That must be the master of the Water Mansion!
Seeing this, Xu Chen still didn't understand.
Shuifu is a conspiracy.
These warriors who entered the Water Mansion fell into the trap of others and became the nourishment for others' recovery.
"The Lord of the Water Mansion cannot be revived, otherwise we will all have to answer here."
The old man in gray shouted.
The next moment.
The old man in gray and the beautiful woman in red rushed towards the blood pool.
Xu Chen thought that what the old man in gray clothes said was reasonable, and he went towards the blood pool without hesitation.
The Lord of the Water Mansion must be killed before he recovers.
But how could things develop so smoothly?
When the old man in gray and the beautiful woman in red were about to rush into the blood pool, a low whistling sound suddenly sounded, and a thick python tail was seen, sweeping with terrifying power and whipping hard.
"Bang!
Bang! "
Although the old man in gray and the beautiful woman in red had spiritual weapons in their hands, they were still shocked and backed away.
"Wow~"
title_en: Chapter 15 Blood Protector Chapter 16 Escape from Water Mansion
